title: crataegus crus-galli var. leptophylla
intro: Crataegus crus-galli var. leptophylla, commonly known as the small-leafed cockspur hawthorn, is a variety of the Crataegus crus-galli species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits. The small-leafed cockspur hawthorn is believed to have various health benefits, including lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels, and has been used to treat cardiovascular issues and improve overall heart health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects.
